blind.description: A stylized carved skull resting atop crossed femurs, mounted on a low, faceted dark grey stone plinth. The skull features exaggerated brow ridges, cracked bone detailing, and teeth clenched over the crossed bones. Surfaces are solid, clean, and hand-painted/stylized with beige-bone tones and charcoal-grey stone.
blind.from_above: From directly above, the rounded top of the skull cranium dominates the center with cracked seams, flanked by the rounded condyles of the crossed bones beneath, bordered by the dark grey rim of the stone base.
blind.extra_base_or_ground: low faceted dark grey stone plinth
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/4 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 1.5 feet tall) and about 2 feet wide at the base.
